node.title: Re^5: Prepocessing perl code / substing variables
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
'cause everybody thinks s/%%(\w+)%%/$vars{$1}/g is enough

Yes, I suspect that is the case...

But I would at least expect missing values reporting

[doc://warnings] about uninitialized variables could cover that, I think.

May be some functionality with quotes escaping or something for better values substitution...

Here's where one starts entering the area of reinventing the [mod://Template] wheel :-)
